page_title: Privacy Policy — AI Business Studio London
heading: Privacy Policy
body:
Confidentiality.We operate under strict confidentiality. We collect basic professional details (name, email, organization, and context) exclusively to assess operational alignment before an engagement begins.

  

Data Security.All submissions are handled as internal confidential intelligence. We strictly reject the sharing, leasing, or distribution of data to external third parties and maintain absolute technological safeguards.
